original_case: When does combining two predictions help?
changed_condition: Now let the correct answer be one instead.
viewer_inference: It still beats the average loss of two, but it does not beat the best model. An exact guarantee can be useful without promising everything.
resolution: For two scalar predictions and any fixed target, average squared loss minus squared loss of the average equals (a−b)²/4. It need not beat the better model.
prerequisite: Operations introduced explicitly in this film
